messages:
Emma: Heads-up — we have a spike in 503s for the embeddings endpoint (customer reports). Need quick marketing + support copy for status page + an inbound lead routing note. Can someone propose timing?
Raj: We started mitigation, routing to warm pool. ETA for stabilization ~20-30m. Hold external comms for now until we confirm no cascade. cc @Emma :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Olivia: For support queue — customers already pinging. Need a short blurb we can paste into replies. Keep it calm, reassure, link to status.
Jamie: Root cause appears to be a KV cache hot-path causing GPU OOMs under a specific prefix distribution. Mitigating by evicting problematic keys and throttling batch sizes. Will post follow-up when we confirm.
Emma: OK — proposal below for two-phase comms. Phase A (holding): internal only; Phase B (external): 30m after stabilization or earlier if we hit 5xx threshold again.
Emma: Suggested statuspage copy (Phase B) — paste as-is:```We are investigating elevated errors for the embeddings API that may affect some requests. Our engineers are actively mitigating the issue and we will update within 30 minutes. If you experience degraded service, please contact support@redwood.ai and we will prioritize.```
Olivia: That reads well. For support replies: "Thanks for the report — we're aware and actively mitigating. We expect an update within 30 minutes. If this impacts production traffic please reply here and we'll escalate."
Lia: Sales/SDR note: route incoming leads from the SPIFF webinar and any enterprise trial accounts to Emma + Lia so we can prioritize outreach. Add a lead tag: "incident-priority".
Raj: Agree on 30m window. Also recommend we avoid sending any scheduled benchmark/webinar posts until we clear — can we freeze social for the afternoon?
Emma: Yes freeze social, delay webinar reminder email by 1 hour. I'll coordinate with content for revised copy once we have confirmed stabilization.
DeployBot: Incident update: mitigation actions applied at 1699001400 — evicted keys and reduced batch size. Monitoring.
Jamie: Seeing 503 rate drop from 2.8% -> 0.4% in last 5m. Still watching KV eviction ripple.
Emma: Great — prepare Phase B publish at +15m if rates stay low. When publishing, use this condensed status page line: ```Partial service disruption for embeddings; mitigation in progress. Next update in 15 minutes.```
Olivia: I'll update the support macro and paste both full and short lines.
Lia: I'll pause the webinar reminders and ping the SDRs to hold outbound.
Emma: Thanks all — I'll draft the status page and share a final copy for sign-off in this thread once we hit the 15m check. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Incident note: next automated check scheduled at 1699001620.
